'''Dalar''' was an [[Ogier]] woman.

==History==
[[Loial]] once told [[Rand al'Thor]] about Dalar, saying that she spent ten years outside a ''[[stedding]]'' with the ''[[Atha'an Miere]]''. The entire time, she went without suffering the [[Longing]].{{ref/book|2|35}} She had returned to her ''stedding'', and according to [[Elder]] [[Haman]], she continued to write, but had to use a walking stick for the rest of her life.{{ref/book|6|20}} Both Loial and Haman refer to Dalar in the past tense, indicating that she died.
